message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"UA_memoryManager_setLimitFromLast4Bytes(data, size)","note":"The fuzz input is attacker-controlled and the last four bytes are reserved for the memory-limit helper, leaving the rest as the packet payload."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_binary_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":41,"var":"msg.data","code":"memcpy(msg.data, data, size)","note":"The payload is copied into a heap buffer and passed unchanged to the server message parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"UA_Server_processBinaryMessage","line":783,"var":"message","code":"UA_Connection_processChunks(connection, server, processCompleteChunk, message)","note":"The server forwards the attacker-controlled packet into the chunk-processing pipeline."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/server/ua_connection.c","function":"processChunk","line":129,"var":"chunk_length","code":"UA_UInt32_decodeBinary(&temp, &temp_offset, &chunk_length)","note":"The chunk length is decoded from the packet header and determines whether the chunk is processed as a complete message."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/server/ua_server_binary.c","function":"processCompleteChunkWithoutChannel","line":700,"var":"request","code":"UA_decodeBinary(msg, &offset, request, requestType, server->config.customDataTypes)","note":"The complete message body is decoded into a typed request object, which can contain nested arrays and strings from the attacker input."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":479,"var":"signed_length","code":"DECODE_DIRECT(&signed_length, UInt32)","note":"Array lengths are read directly from the message and control the number of elements to allocate and decode."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":494,"var":"*dst","code":"*dst = UA_calloc(length, type->memSize)","note":"The decoder allocates heap storage for the array before decoding its elements."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":504,"var":"ret","code":"ret = decodeBinaryJumpTable[type->typeKind]((void*)ptr, type, ctx)","note":"Each element is decoded recursively, so a later malformed element can fail after earlier elements have already been initialized."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_binary.c","function":"Array_decodeBinary","line":507,"var":"*dst","code":"UA_Array_delete(*dst, i+1, type)","note":"On failure, the decoder frees the initialized prefix of the array, including nested strings and structures."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE])","note":"String cleanup frees the byte buffer for each nested string field during array teardown."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"clearStructure","line":996,"var":"ptr","code":"UA_Array_delete(*(void**)ptr, length, mt)","note":"Structure cleanup recursively frees nested members, so the same string buffer can be reached again if the parent object is later cleared."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/pubsub/ua_pubsub_networkmessage.c","function":"UA_NetworkMessage_decodeBinary","line":150,"var":"dst","code":"UA_NetworkMessage_deleteMembers(dst)","note":"When decoding a malformed PubSub network message fails, the top-level cleanup runs after the recursive array cleanup, producing the use-after-free read in the reported crash state."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/tests/pubsub/check_pubsub_encoding.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
